name: 1401-longdecode-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct. Ungated on the Hub, 31.4 GB of bf16 safetensors, needs trust-remote-code.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 27 layers, MLA + MoE, 15.7B total / 2.4B active, bf16. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 600 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix: prompts centred on 256 tokens (stdev 32, clamped 64-512) and generations centred on 512 tokens (stdev 32, clamped 128-768), every request an independent draw. Seed 42.
purpose: A coding assistant generating long code completions from short prompts for 16 concurrent developers on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only. An indented block is dropped by the engine's line reader and the
# server then starts without the key it declares, at rc=0.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration/modeling modules and its tokenizer needs them.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1
enable-mla: true
disable-radix-cache: true

# LOAD-BEARING, not cosmetic: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions and the engine sizes
# device-side per-request tables from that number, which at the advertised window is terabytes
# and the server never starts. The longest possible request here is 512 + 768 = 1280.
context-length: 8192

mem-fraction-static: 0.80
random-seed: 42
